# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For the PnP PowerShell repository, use the root-level `../.github/copilot-instructions.md` file as the authoritative Copilot instructions file rather than this `src/.github` copy.
- For the PnP PowerShell repository, never add repository guidance to `src/.github/copilot-instructions.md`; always add it only to the root-level `.github/copilot-instructions.md` file.
- For future project guidance and memory items, add them to the root-level `.github/copilot-instructions.md` file rather than workspace-local instruction files.
